search_text: published ZDI-13-262 ZDI-CAN-1759 HP Application Lifecycle Management GossipService SOAP Request Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2013-11-24 CVE-2013-4836 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2013-4836 7.5 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Application Lifecycle Management'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Application Lifecycle Management. title: HP Application Lifecycle Management GossipService SOAP Request Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Application Lifecycle Management. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the web service named GossipServiceSoapBinding. This web service is vulnerable to SQL injection. A remote attacker can leverage this to gain remote code execution under the context of the postgres user.
